rules.name: Liability must be capped
rules.policy_text: The counterparty's total liability under the contract must be subject to a stated cap or limit.
rules.recommendation_template: Check whether the contract states an aggregate cap on liability and what it covers.

rules.name: No unlimited liability
rules.policy_text: Neither party should accept unlimited or uncapped liability for losses or damages.
rules.recommendation_template: Review whether any party is exposed to unlimited liability and whether a cap should apply.

rules.name: Minimum termination notice
rules.policy_text: Either party's right to terminate for convenience must require at least 30 days' prior written notice.
rules.recommendation_template: Review whether the notice period can be extended to at least 30 days.

rules.name: Mutual termination rights
rules.policy_text: A right to terminate for convenience must not be granted only to the counterparty; termination rights should be mutual.
rules.recommendation_template: Check whether our organization has the same right to terminate for convenience as the counterparty.

rules.name: No automatic renewal
rules.policy_text: The contract must not renew automatically; any renewal should require mutual written agreement.
rules.recommendation_template: Check the renewal mechanism and any deadline for giving notice of non-renewal.

rules.name: SLA required
rules.policy_text: The contract must contain a service level agreement covering availability, response or resolution times, and service credits.
rules.recommendation_template: Check whether service levels are defined in the contract or in an attached schedule.

rules.name: Confidentiality clause required
rules.policy_text: The contract must contain a confidentiality clause protecting non-public information disclosed by either party.
rules.recommendation_template: Check whether confidential information is protected and for how long.

rules.name: Indian governing law
rules.policy_text: The contract must be governed by the laws of India.
rules.recommendation_template: Check the governing law and jurisdiction clause and whether Indian law can apply.

rules.name: Payment terms at least 30 days
rules.policy_text: Invoices must be payable no earlier than 30 days after receipt.
rules.recommendation_template: Review whether the payment period can be extended to at least 30 days.

rules.name: Indemnification clause required
rules.policy_text: The contract must contain an indemnification clause under which the counterparty indemnifies our organization.
rules.recommendation_template: Check whether the counterparty indemnifies our organization, for example against third-party claims.
